% Graphics in boxes saved with lrbox, \sbox, and \savebox, placed in a
% TikZ node: a PNG, a PDF, a JPEG, and an EPS. A box placed in a node and
% then in the text keeps its picture as an image of the page there.
% Graphics typed inside a picture: a TikZ node, a LaTeX picture, an
% overpic, a node in a \resizebox that changes its aspect, a trimmed and
% clipped PNG, a PNG turned by angle, a PNG in a \scalebox, and a PNG
% turned in a LaTeX picture, where it is outside the picture's frame. A
% saved TikZ picture with a graphic placed twice. A TikZ picture without
% a graphic follows the theme, and one with a turned label and a labeled
% arrow that pgf leaves out of its bounding box is as wide as in the PDF.
% A TikZ picture with a graphic in a figure, which opens the viewer.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{overpic}
\usepackage{pict2e}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newsavebox{\keep}
\newsavebox{\twice}
\begin{document}
\sbox{\twice}{\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[width=1cm]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}}
Before lrbox png.
\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
Some text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-bare.png}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw,rounded corners] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After lrbox png.

Before lrbox pdf.
\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
More text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw,rounded corners] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After lrbox pdf.

Before sbox jpg.
\sbox{\keep}{\includegraphics[height=30pt]{test-overpic-photo.jpg}}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After sbox jpg.

Before savebox eps.
\savebox{\keep}{\includegraphics[width=72pt]{test-inputname-epsf.eps}}
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After savebox eps.

\begin{lrbox}{\keep}\begin{minipage}{0.8\linewidth}
Kept text.
\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=0.5\linewidth]{test-bare.png}\end{center}
\end{minipage}\end{lrbox}
Before node copy.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\usebox{\keep}};\end{tikzpicture}

After node copy.

Before text copy.
\usebox{\keep}

After text copy.

Before node png.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}

After node png.

Before picture pdf.
\setlength{\unitlength}{1pt}
\begin{picture}(80,60)
\put(0,0){\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}
\put(10,10){R}
\end{picture}

After picture pdf.

Before overpic png.
\begin{overpic}[width=80pt]{test-bare.png}\put(10,10){A}\end{overpic}

After overpic png.

Before resized node.
\resizebox{3cm}{1cm}{\begin{tikzpicture}\node{\includegraphics[width=1cm]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}}

After resized node.

Before trimmed png.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[trim=0 0 32 0,clip,width=2cm]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}

After trimmed png.

Before turned png.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[angle=90,width=2cm]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}

After turned png.

Before scaled png.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\scalebox{2}{\includegraphics[width=1cm]{test-bare.png}}};\end{tikzpicture}

After scaled png.

Before turned in picture.
\begin{picture}(40,60)\put(40,0){\rotatebox{90}{\includegraphics[width=60pt]{test-bare.png}}}\end{picture}

After turned in picture.

Before twice.
\usebox{\twice} \usebox{\twice}

After twice.

Before plain node.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {Plain};\end{tikzpicture}

After plain node.

Before turned label.
\begin{tikzpicture}\node (a) {\rotatebox{90}{L}}; \draw[overlay,->] (a) -- ++(4,0) node[right] {R};\end{tikzpicture}

After turned label.

\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}\node[draw] {\includegraphics[width=2cm]{test-bare.png}};\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{A graphic in a TikZ picture, which opens the viewer.}
\end{figure}
\end{document}
